cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.

mechanism: A manages an exhibition opening but adjusts timing around B captain role while requiring B to name the sibling relationship as the reason for leaving.
confusable: Unlike attendance alone, A wants the rearrangement openly attributed to the relationship; confident hosting depends on accommodating B obligations.
comparison: Family opening and face-saving public explanation differ from privately purchasing a specific lunch slot from an old friend.
seedUse: Use D35-b quiz captain/round one/headache sequence and S02-b adapting command method to keep the participant.
